newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers; 44,400 head confirmed for week to date.
The last established price was $65.00 per cwt on Friday.
Today's packer bids are $64.00 with asking prices
$66.00-$67.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights
FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - Holiday Week Ago - None
Wk to Date - 44,400 Week Ago - 6,300 Week Ago - 26,700
